Data are currently deficient (Tier 4) for endocrine disruption (EDC) and organ/systemic (OGN) hazards.

Q3: 2,3-Dichloro-1-propene appears relatively well-characterized within the context of petrochemical materials, supported by 1362 scientific literature references and a defined molecular formula.
